tips_en: Start with the AgentGarten paper (Paper 1), as it tackles the most ambitious and broadly impactful problem — scalable, interactive training environments for evolving AI agents — by elegantly decoupling state evolution from rendering via code worlds. Papers 1 and 2 are tightly connected: AgentGarten provides environments where agents could be trained and evaluated, while Paper 2 offers a rigorous benchmark methodology for testing whether agents truly learn from experience. Paper 3 (TokenRouter) stands alone as a systems contribution, but could be indirectly relevant for serving the large models needed to power such agents at scale.
tips_zh: 建议首先阅读 AgentGarten 论文（论文1），它解决了最具雄心和广泛影响力的问题——通过代码世界将状态演化与渲染解耦，为不断进化的智能体提供可扩展、可交互的训练环境。论文1和论文2紧密相关：AgentGarten 提供了智能体训练与评估的环境，而论文2则提供了一种严格的基准测试方法，用于检验智能体是否真正从经验中学习。论文3（TokenRouter）作为系统优化方向独立存在，但间接相关——它的高效推理能力对大规模部署驱动此类智能体的模型具有实际价值。
